scientific_limitations: Requires positive bounded operators with simple isolated minimum eigenvalues and a cyclic bottom eigenvector, as in Tian Theorem 5.1.
The theorem concerns the minimal joint Naimark dilation and its spectral multiplicity, not arbitrary nonminimal dilations.
The source supplies the positive POVM decomposition; only the explicit minimal spectral multiplicities and critical partition are assessed as the new claim.
Bibliographic risk: related POVM direct-integral literature may contain an implicit equivalent treatment.
title: Spectral multiplicity phase transition in bilinear-resolvent Naimark dilations
